blockbuilder.visual_critic_note: Intentional dark theme with a controlled single-accent palette (#4477AA) and genuine typographic hierarchy (uppercase panel labels, muted status text), but the network and color-usage panels are too dense at rendered size — node labels overlap and the dot scatter reads as noise rather than signal.
blockbuilder.encoding_integrity_note: All three views use scaleSqrt for area encoding, zero-baseline bar chart with data-driven domain, and fixed semantic domains for hue/lightness axes — no honesty violations found.
flags: Update Storm (partial): bitFilter.set() iterates all 34k blocks synchronously inside brush 'brush end' on every mousemove before RAF deferral
Stale Scale (minor): no window resize handler means x/y scales captured in brush closures become stale if viewport changes
blockbuilder.stress_test_note: Excellent dirty-flag + RAF architecture prevents DOM update storms and feedback loops, but expensive O(n) bitmasking runs synchronously inside brush handlers on every mousemove rather than being deferred to the RAF flush.
blockbuilder.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views and clean dark layout keep the dashboard manageable, but the color-usage panel's hundreds of tiny undifferentiated dots convey no extractable pattern at a glance, and the 60-node force network is near the hairball threshold — structure is visible but detail requires hovering.
